items.description: Budyko curve: mean annual evapotranspiration ratio E/P as a function of aridity index phi = PET/P, E/P = sqrt(phi * tanh(1/phi) * (1 - exp(-phi)))
items.note: Values computed from the formula; runoff_ratio = 1 - evaporative_ratio for a catchment in long-term steady state. Real catchments scatter about +/-0.1 in E/P around the curve.

items.description: Fu-Zhang parameter omega in E/P = 1 + phi - (1 + phi^omega)^(1/omega) fitted to global catchments
items.note: omega = 2.6 reproduces the Budyko curve; forested catchments sit higher, grassland lower.

items.description: Hack's law: main-stream length L = c * A^h
items.unit: L in km, A in km2
items.note: Hack's original fit is L = 1.4 A^0.6 in miles and square miles; converted: 1.4 * 1.609 / 2.590^0.6 = 1.27 for km and km2. Exponent 0.5-0.6 across basins worldwide.

items.description: Exponent b in mean annual discharge Q ~ A^b within a climatically uniform region
Exponent theta in flood quantile Q_T ~ A^theta (peak discharge scaling with catchment area)
items.note: Flood peaks grow less than linearly with area because storms do not cover large catchments uniformly.

items.description: Ratio of the 100-year flood to the mean annual flood, temperate humid catchments
items.note: Regional growth curves in New Zealand (McKerchar & Pearson 1989) and the UK (NERC 1975) give Q100/mean annual flood of about 2-3 in most regions.

items.description: Return period of bankfull discharge in alluvial rivers
